conditions.stress_beats: filtered net Sharpe > always-take net Sharpe at 1.5x, 2x and 3x spread multipliers, each recomputed from re-resolved stressed economics

absolute_bar.evaluator: s5_eval.evaluate_bar (mechanical; verdict + failed conditions returned, never hardcoded)

calibration_separation: Brier/log-loss on enter+latent over CLOSED labels only; NEVER mixed into efficacy or portfolio metrics.

costs.note: stress enters through backtest.resolve(spread_mult), never by scaling a 1x number

created: v2 supersedes v1 BEFORE any corrected-harness comparison is computed; v1 rationale preserved in git history. Variant names reconciled to implementation; resampling fixed to day-cluster bootstrap; sequential + power + bar-evaluator gaps closed.

holdout.access: holdout_split() is FINAL-path only, called after select_variant() freezes on folds; select_variant takes metrics only (signature-guarded); regression test proves no records/holdout parameter
holdout.definition: final time segment from holdout_split (walk_folds segments + 1)

holm.family: ONE pooled Holm over the union of declared variants (no per-family Holms)
holm.p_value: cluster_null_p: P(centered day-cluster bootstrap mean >= observed mean)
holm.statistic: mean paired delta (filtered_R - always_R) on the holdout window

leakage_guards: stream built first from bars[..i] only
walk-forward with purge of boundary-overlapping labels + embargo gap
no JEV-derived label in the JEV decision
power study on train folds only; holdout CIDs never enter power/sequential inputs

policies.ALWAYS_TAKE: take every realized non-disqualified candidate at frozen economics
policies.JEV_FILTERED: v4 evaluate under the variant reading; take only accepted; HOLD never fills; disqualified never taken by either policy

portfolio.admission: mirrors backtest.run (exits-first, one-per-symbol, max 3, 75% total notional, evolving realized equity)
portfolio.curve: daily equity with opens marked at session closes; zero-days kept; final session settles
portfolio.returns: daily equity-relative changes; Sharpe = daily x sqrt(252); HAC SE Newey-West

power.dependence: train stream's own day-clusters, centered then shifted by MDE
power.effect_MDE: +0.15 mean paired R (declared before any JEV comparison; NOT estimated from results)
power.required_N: smallest size multiplier with power >= target (None if unreached)

resampling.clusters: UTC snapshot day of the candidate (snapshot_ts date)
resampling.null_test: H0-centered day-cluster bootstrap, B=2000, seed 24270 (seed+1); p = P(boot >= observed); one-sided H1: mean > 0
resampling.procedure: day-cluster bootstrap (cluster-aware): resample whole snapshot-day clusters with replacement; preserves within-day dependence

search_budget.note: v4 table FROZEN; variants are pre-declared readings of the same signed answers on the same window; Holm pools them.

sequential_rule.alpha_split: Bonferroni 0.025 interim + 0.025 final (conservative under dependence; fixed, no post-hoc looks)
sequential_rule.decision: interim: mean<=0 -> stop-futility; null p<0.025 -> stop-efficacy; else continue. Final: null p<0.025 -> efficacy else fail.
looks: interim at 50% of closed deltas by snapshot order

filtered-conv-any.decision_rule: take iff frozen v4 verdict in (PASS_BASE, PASS_ELEVATED_ELIGIBLE)

filtered-enter-gte-80-strong-plus.decision_rule: take iff PASS_* AND answers.enter >= 0.8 AND answers.conviction in (strong, max)

window.answers: stub-deterministic-v1 ONLY for harness/pipeline proof - zero JEV-value claim until live-provider answers run under this same protocol
window.stream: synthetic deterministic stream (unit proofs) + S2 validation slice candidates (pipeline proof)

amendment_a.final_module: holdout_split + final_report live in research/strategy/s5_final.py; s5_eval exposes no holdout API (asserted); selection imports s5_eval only
amendment_a.policy_R: disqualified candidates contribute zero policy R to both policies (diagnostic resolved_r + label retained); paired delta 0; never in portfolios
amendment_a.breach: r_breach_attempted = disqualified AND JEV PASS AND realized; final_report sums it into r_breach_taken consumed by no_r_breach
amendment_a.holm: proper step-down adjusted p-values with monotone cummax
amendment_a.portfolio: single chronological sweep (entries open at/after snapshot ts, exits settle at exit ts with exits-first, marks only after entry, sizing on realized equity); still-open positions stay open marked at last close
amendment_a.reason: re-audit FAIL findings 1-6 corrected; Variants/H0/alphas/MDE/search budget unchanged from v2

amendment_b.purge: walk_folds requires holdout_start (boundary timestamp, not data); every selection record satisfies time_exit_ns < holdout_start; last test fold purged too; holdout_split asserts invariant + disjointness
amendment_b.n_closed: FILTERED-POLICY taken closed trades only (filtered portfolio trades with win/loss labels, post-admission); HOLDs/rejects/disqualified/censored never count
amendment_b.stress: exact key set {1.5x,2x,3x}, each a finite (filtered, always) Sharpe pair from re-resolved economics; anything else fails closed
amendment_b.r_classification: CHECKED (R1-positions, R1-same-direction, R2-single, R2-total, R3-churn, R4-fliplock, R8-maxgate via v4, R12, R14, stop-rule), NOT_APPLICABLE (R10-spend, R11-isolation, R13-calib, R15-caps, R16-killswitch, R17-escalation), UNAVAILABLE (R1-pending, R2-pending, R5-halt, R6-vol, R7-corr, R9-venue)
amendment_b.r_out_of_scope_rationale: each needs live/online authoritative inputs absent in research (order/ack + account state, per-cycle snapshot equity + persisted HWMs for R5 intraday spike-to-trough, 480+24h vol baselines with data-age gates, trailing-30 correlation engine with freshness gates, broker adapter + venue calendar); no_r_breach means no taken trade violated a CHECKED rule; scope fails closed if any other rule is UNAVAILABLE
amendment_b.r_monitor: s5_eval.verify_r_monitor post-hoc verifies R3/R4/R5/R1-direction/R2-concurrency on the filtered taken ledger; violations join r_breach_attempted in r_breach_count
amendment_b.finalization: s5_final holds holdout_split + final_report; holdout is terminal evidence, never fed back into select_variant; selected_variant may be echoed only

amendment_c.holdout_materialization: final 1x/stress sets MUST equal the exact holdout CID set from holdout_split (s5_final.assert_exact_holdout); day-membership reconstruction rejected; holdout_cids is a required final_report input
amendment_c.curve: principal accounting on frozen adverse entry_fill (open BUY immediately reflects entry cost); curve[0] is starting equity (pre-window baseline) so first-session return and drawdown-from-capital are represented; frozen daily-close marking otherwise unchanged
amendment_c.r5: UNAVAILABLE (see amendment_b): S5 daily-close marks cannot observe intraday spike-to-trough against persisted HWMs; a hostile intraday-spike/recovery test proves the monitor boundary honest
amendment_c.sequential: closed_stream: win/loss labels ONLY (censored/excluded/disqualified never enter), snapshot-ordered; sequential evidence is computed on the fold-selected variant (selection on folds first, no holdout choice); final Holm still pools both pre-declared variants
amendment_c.power: record inputs, deduplicated by CID (n_unique_cids reported); each bootstrap cluster draw keeps a distinct synthetic label (repeated source draws never collapse); train-only, holdout-excluded
amendment_c.embargo: walk_folds derives the embargo horizon from pre-holdout records only when holdout_start is supplied; holdout time_exit metadata never enters selection
amendment_c.frozen_scope: final_report reads amendment_b r_out_of_scope from the committed prereg file (s5_final.frozen_scope); no caller-supplied scope accepted; the used list is echoed as rep[r_scope_frozen]
